name: The Zhevra
summary: At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn sends young Horde warriors after the zhevra. Their hunt tests the skills needed to face the Barrens' more dangerous beasts.

sections.title: A Step Up in the Savanna
sections.body: After the plainstriders, Sergra Darkthorn sends you after tougher prey. Zhevras run in herds across the northern and southern Barrens. They are not the savanna's fiercest beasts, but they are swift and stubborn, and their kicks can break bone.

sections.title: The Trials of Darkthorn
sections.body: Sergra uses the hunt to test your growing skill. She asks for four intact hooves as proof of the kill and warns that a zhevra's rear kick can knock a grown tauren onto their haunches. Passing this trial brings you closer to facing the plains' predatory prowlers.

faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn, an experienced orc shaman at the Crossroads in the central Barrens, sets this trial to test growing Horde warriors.
Zhevra runners roam the open plains north and south of the Crossroads in the central Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Sergra want zhevra hooves?
faq.answer: The hooves prove that you killed a zhevra. Bringing back four shows you overcame a beast whose powerful legs can knock down even a mighty tauren.
After you prove yourself against zhevra, Sergra tests you against the Barrens' predators in Prowlers of the Barrens.
Zhevras are usually passive grazers, but their legs are powerful. Sergra warns that a startled or cornered runner can knock even a sturdy tauren flat with one kick.

faq.q: Why were plainstriders hunted before this?
faq.answer: Sergra makes her trials harder step by step. Plainstriders are the first target; zhevras are faster and stronger prey, preparing you to face aggressive savanna prowlers.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know how forceful a zhevra's kick can be. Sergra warns that it can knock a full-grown tauren off their hooves.
As a hunter learning the Barrens, you can sharpen your tracking and aim by stalking swift zhevra herds.
As a member of the Horde, you help the Crossroads manage the surrounding wildlife and keep its supply routes clear.
